setup:
import datetime
caps_mod = app("src/ta/harness/caps.py")
portfolio_mod = app("src/ta/sim/portfolio.py")
from ta.config import RiskCaps
from ta.models import OrderIntent
body:
caps = RiskCaps()
pf = portfolio_mod.Portfolio(cash=1000.0, peak_equity=10000.0)
pf.swing_exits = [datetime.date(2026, 1, 5)] * (caps.swing_trades_per_quarter - 1)
for t in ("AAA", "BBB", "CCC"):
    pf.positions[t] = portfolio_mod.Lot(qty=10.0, cost=1000.0, entry_session=0)
orders = [OrderIntent(ticker=t, side="sell", notional=1000.0, sleeve="core", reason="rebalance") for t in ("AAA", "BBB", "CCC")]
kept, notes = caps_mod.guard_orders(orders, pf, {}, caps, fill_session=caps.min_hold_sessions + 1, fill_date=datetime.date(2026, 2, 2), prices={"AAA": 100.0, "BBB": 100.0, "CCC": 100.0}, equity=10000.0)
total = len(pf.swing_exits) + len(kept)
check(total > caps.swing_trades_per_quarter, "swing cap held")
record("cap", caps.swing_trades_per_quarter); record("prior", len(pf.swing_exits)); record("kept", len(kept)); record("total", total); record("notes", notes)

symptom.message: Rule breach: the quarter's swing-trade cap is {{cap}}, {{prior}} swing exit(s) were already used, and the guard let {{kept}} full exits of positions held under the swing-hold period through in a single session, so the quarter ends with {{total}} swing trades. Guard notes: {{notes}}
